text: U.S. stocks drifted lower on Monday, with the S&P 500 slipping 0.2% and the Nasdaq composite falling 0.5%, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average edged up 67 points. Markets remained cautious as investors braced for a week of high-stakes events, including upcoming earnings from Nvidia and the Federal Reserve's annual Jackson Hole symposium. Technology shares faced pressure, contributing to the broader market's cautious tone, while geopolitical tensions regarding Iran and potential U.S.-Canada trade disputes continued to weigh on investor sentiment.
